rules: Any liquid asset: stock, crypto, or leveraged/inverse ETF
Rotate each 6:30am CT run — sell yesterday, buy today's best
Leverage matched to conviction; asymmetric payoff preferred
Hard stop at entry; spot-crypto-only on weekends

positions.name: Bitcoin
positions.catalyst: Saturday — US equity/ETF markets closed, so spot crypto is the only tradable universe. Tape is risk-off into the weekend: BTC has slipped below $64k on renewed US-Iran tensions and a Fed hold, with ~$527M of BTC spot-ETF outflows and a broad crypto pullback (SOL -2.5%, ETH capped at resistance). Rather than a fresh bullish catalyst, the setup is volatility compression: BTC is consolidating in a tight range near the lower boundary of its channel, coiling for a directional break. Long spot BTC is the most downside-protected way to hold exposure over a 24h window where the next move is more likely a mean-revert bounce off support than a fresh leg down.
positions.driver: LONG spot BTC-USD (unleveraged, 100% capital). Weekend rules forbid leveraged/equity vehicles, so the choice is among spot BTC/ETH/SOL. Picked BTC as the lowest-vol, highest-liquidity, most-downside-protected instrument on a low-edge risk-off day — exactly the 'park in lower-vol/spot' mandate. BTC has the deepest bid and the least idiosyncratic headwind: SOL carries a live DeFi-slowdown narrative and ETH is pinned under resistance, both higher-beta into a weak tape. No leverage today because there is no fresh catalyst to justify it and downside protection is the priority; hard 10% spot-crypto stop caps the loss. Runners-up: ETH (passed — stuck below key resistance, higher beta), SOL (passed — DeFi-slowdown headwind + -2.5% weakness makes long the wrong side).
positions.risks: Directional risk into a risk-off weekend: if US-Iran tensions escalate or ETF-outflow selling continues, BTC can break the lower channel and trip the stop. Crypto trades 24/7, so a weekend liquidity air-pocket can gap through the 56,709.85 stop before rotation. Mitigant: BTC is the least volatile major, spot avoids leverage decay, and the position sits near support where risk/reward favors a bounce.
